column1: # Known differences between scopeio and the reference readers.

column4: bioformats-rs returns the stored volume padded to whole chunks (2048 x 2048) instead of the extent of the ImageSizeX/Y attributes (1949 x 1949), which Bio-Formats also reports
bioformats-rs returns the stored volume padded to whole chunks (height 1792) instead of the ImageSizeY extent (1567)
bioformats-rs returns the padded z extent (48 planes) instead of ImageSizeZ (47)
